text:
Elias Pettersson missed practice on Tuesday, and Canucks GM Ryan Johnson said on Halford and Brough that he is traveling with the team and will see a specialist on the East Coast, as David Quadrelli of The Nation Network reported. Daily Hive called the update murky.

The season had been hard to read even before. Pettersson has 23 points in 24 games, but only 6 goals on 30 shots, and his shooting (20%) is far above the 11% to 16% our numbers see as his normal. Vancouver has scored 9.3 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and at five on five the Canucks take just 41% of the expected goals when he plays. They're worse without him. Evolving-Hockey said last season his teammates ranked in the bottom 5% while his competition ranked in the 90th percentile. He's the 2019 Calder winner, a player built to be a top center, now waiting on a specialist.
headline: Pettersson's injury clouds a puzzling season
